items: 1 loaf ciabatta bread, (or similar hearty bread)
3 tomatoes, (large and very ripe tomatoes are best, I used heirloom tomatoes)

steps: Get ready. Turn on your oven’s broiler and position a rack about 6 inches from the heat.

Toast the bread. Slice the loaf in half lengthwise, then cut it into 2-inch slices. Brush the bread generously with extra virgin olive oil and arrange it on a sheet pan. Broil for up to 3 minutes, until lightly golden brown.

Grate the tomatoes. Slice a small piece from the tip of each tomato. Grate the cut side over the large holes of a box grater and into a bowl, stopping when only the peel remains. Discard the peels. Season the tomato pulp with salt and an optional splash of lime juice.
Assemble and serve. While the bread is hot, rub the cut side of the garlic cloves over the surface. Spread the grated tomatoes over the bread and serve immediately.
